> What is your rclone version (eg output from `rclone -V`)
rclone v1.37-041-g21aca686β
> Which OS you are using and how many bits (eg Windows 7, 64 bit)
Ubuntu 17.04, 64 bit
> Which cloud storage system are you using? (eg Google Drive)
HTTP
> The command you were trying to run (eg `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)
"rclone ls test:" or "rclone copy test: /tmp"

Filenames containing characters like ":" (encoded as "%3a") or "%" ("Now 100% better.mp3") cause the latest rclone beta to skip these files. (rclone v1.37 crashes as discussed in #1555)

It would be great if rclone could replace these characters with something like underscore.

body: This should all be fixed now - please try [the latest beta](https://beta.rclone.org) and re-open if not.
